description: Hi! I'm an AI student with skills in ESP32/Arduino, Python, C++, Java & UI design (Figma). Leading team RASD (رَصْد) in NASA Space Apps ("Be An Earth System Trend Detective!" track). We are building an AI-driven wildfire prediction & evacuation system using NASA satellite data & IoT. Looking for teammates in ML, satellite data, web/mobile app dev, & presentation pitch. Join us to save lives with space tech!
